# Book & Shores

> Book & Shores (bookandshores.com) is an independent book-recommendation site. We hand-pick new and notable books (Booker Prize 2026 titles, surf and sea reads, art books, classics and small-press finds) and link to buy each one from independent bookstores through Bookshop.org.

Affiliate disclosure: Book & Shores earns a small commission from Bookshop.org purchases, which supports independent bookstores. Buy links use our Bookshop.org affiliate storefront (https://bookshop.org/a/125864/<ISBN>). Readers can also tip the site directly on PayPal ("Tip the Booktender"). Contact: readme@bookandshores.com

## Weekly Reads and book pages

- [The Talented Mr. Ripley by Patricia Highsmith](https://bookandshores.com/book-talented-mr-ripley.html): Weekly Read. The classic noir that inspired the new film A Talent for Murder (in theaters October 23, 2026). W. W. Norton paperback, ISBN 9780393332148.
- [Carol by Patricia Highsmith](https://bookandshores.com/book-carol.html): Bonus Weekly Read alongside Ripley. First published in 1952 as The Price of Salt. W. W. Norton paperback, ISBN 9780393325997.
- [The End of Everything by M. John Harrison](https://bookandshores.com/book-the-end-of-everything.html): Shortlisted for the 2026 Booker Prize. Riverhead Books hardcover, October 13, 2026, ISBN 9798217438655.
- [Switzy by Emma Cline](https://bookandshores.com/book-switzy.html): Longlisted for the 2026 Booker Prize. Random House, 2026, ISBN 9780593595244.
- [Helen of Nowhere by Makenna Goodman](https://bookandshores.com/book-helen-of-nowhere.html): Longlisted for the 2026 Booker Prize. Coffee House Press, ISBN 9781566897358.
- [All Them Dogs by Djamel White](https://bookandshores.com/book-all-them-dogs.html): Longlisted for the 2026 Booker Prize; a debut set in West Dublin gangland. Riverhead, 2026, ISBN 9798217046676.
- [Ambivalence: An Education by Brian Dillon](https://bookandshores.com/book-ambivalence.html): Memoir of growing up in 1980s and 90s Dublin through books and ideas. New York Review Books, 2026, ISBN 9798896231103.
- [Sound Within Sound: Radical Composers of the Twentieth Century by Kate Molleson](https://bookandshores.com/book-sound-within-sound.html): Music history profiling a dozen overlooked 20th-century composers, nearly all women or composers of color. Abrams Press hardcover, November 15, 2022, ISBN 9781419753565.
- [The Space Behind the Face: Life Stories by Robert Wilson with Keith McDermott](https://bookandshores.com/book-space-behind-the-face.html): The late theater artist's memoir, from Texas to Einstein on the Beach. Penguin Press hardcover, November 3, 2026 (pre-order), ISBN 9798217061273.
- [The Sandman by Lars Kepler](https://bookandshores.com/book-the-sandman.html): Swedish crime thriller (Joona Linna and Saga Bauer vs. Jurek Walter), translated by Neil Smith; basis for Apple TV's Nocturne, premiering October 30, 2026. Vintage Crime/Black Lizard paperback, January 8, 2019, ISBN 9780525433057.
- [Susan Sontag: The Collected Essays, edited by David Rieff](https://bookandshores.com/book-susan-sontag-collected-essays.html): Library of America's two-volume boxed set of Sontag's essays: nine complete collections, from Against Interpretation to At the Same Time, plus six uncollected essays. Boxed set, 1,740 pages, November 3, 2026 (pre-order), ISBN 9781598538595.
- [Mad Eden by Morgan Thomas](https://bookandshores.com/book-mad-eden.html): Morgan Thomas's debut novel: Ro, a trans patient navigator in Florida newly diagnosed with autism, sees their life with Liam spin toward disaster. 2026 National Book Award finalist, Fiction. MCD/FSG hardcover, June 2, 2026, ISBN 9780374620158.
- [Dèy by Edwidge Danticat](https://bookandshores.com/book-dey.html): Edwidge Danticat's novel: Magnolia, a Haitian American real estate agent in Miami, survives a mall shooting and tells no one. Title is the Haitian Kreyol word for mourning. 2026 National Book Award finalist, Fiction. Knopf hardcover, August 25, 2026, ISBN 9780593803523.
- [Huna by Abdelrahman ElGendy](https://bookandshores.com/book-huna.html): Abdelrahman ElGendy's debut memoir: arrested with his father at a Cairo demonstration at 17 in 2013, he spent six years as a political prisoner and earned an engineering degree inside. 2026 National Book Award finalist, Nonfiction. Hogarth hardcover, September 1, 2026, ISBN 9798217153602.
- [Mother Tongue by Sara Nović](https://bookandshores.com/book-mother-tongue.html): Sara Novic's memoir of leaving the hearing world for the Deaf community and American Sign Language, and of raising one hearing son and one adopted deaf son. 2026 National Book Award finalist, Nonfiction. Random House hardcover, May 5, 2026, ISBN 9780593241530.
- [Pure Men by Mohamed Mbougar Sarr](https://bookandshores.com/book-pure-men.html): Mohamed Mbougar Sarr's novel, translated by Lara Vergnaud: a Dakar French literature teacher is haunted by a viral video of a crowd exhuming a man's body. 2026 National Book Award finalist, Translated Literature. Other Press paperback, June 2, 2026, ISBN 9781635424706.

## Lists

- [Bookstore](https://bookandshores.com/bookstore.html): The full A–Z shelf of Book & Shores picks, with a search bar for any book. Every pick links to Bookshop.org.
- [Booker Prize 2026 shortlist](https://bookandshores.com/booker-2026-shortlist.html): All six shortlisted novels, a sentence each. The winner is announced November 9, 2026.
- [Booker Prize 2026 longlist picks](https://bookandshores.com/booker-2026-longlist.html): Three longlisted novels hand-picked by Book & Shores: Switzy, Helen of Nowhere and All Them Dogs.
- [Author of the Month: Jonathan Lethem](https://bookandshores.com/author-of-the-month.html): Where to start, six of his best books, and Office Politics, the lost novel in his new NYRB essay.
